data.name: Marfaat
data.gender_notes: Marfaat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who leads, guides, or shows the way. The name Marfaat carries the meaning “The Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Marfaat usually hope their child will grow to embody the guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Marfaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marfaat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Marfaat
in_english.meaning: Complete knowledge and awareness of truth
in_english.long_meaning: Marfaat is an Arabic-originated name that signifies complete knowledge and awareness of truth. Derived from the Arabic root 'عرف' (arafa), which means 'to know' or 'to understand', this name highlights the importance of knowledge and wisdom in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes a person with deep understanding and insight into the realities of life
